title: Reading Drill — Measuring how books fade in windows — Reviewing the evidence
description: One short passage, six questions. Recommended time: 10 minutes.

passages.title: Measuring how books fade in windows — Reviewing the evidence
passages.body:
**A** The bookseller in Elmbrook received an old report about display copies losing colour before they are sold. The report compared the change in cover colour, but some entries had been collected under different conditions. To check the report, reviewers returned to the colour reference cards rather than treating the published figures as a complete record.

**B** The review covered four weeks. In the first part of that period, the original records did not consistently include differing paper finishes. In the later part, the recording sheet included a separate field for it. The reviewers kept readings from both periods, but marked which items were missing rather than guessing what had happened.

**C** The conclusion listed swapped copies on display as a possible later response. It recommended collecting another set of readings before deciding whether to use it. The new data would be published with the method, so another group could work out whether its own measurements were comparable.
